content: {"paper_id":"W3188900617","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","exact_quote":"Recovering missing data from incomplete traffic data becomes an important issue for ITS.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文研究从含有缺失的交通数据中恢复缺失观测，输出为恢复后的数据，符合数据补全与恢复任务。"},{"keyword_id":"traffic-data","exact_quote":"incomplete traffic data due to sensor malfunctions and communication faults","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"以道路交通数据为实际对象，研究其不完整与恢复问题。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"Furthermore, we propose a novel graph spectral regularized tensor completion algorithm based on GT-SVD and construct temporal regularized constraints to improve the recovery accuracy.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"提出图谱正则化的张量补全算法，利用路网图拓扑/图傅里叶结构对补全过程施加几何一致性约束。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"utilize an algebraic framework termed as graph-tensor singular value decompositions (GT-SVD) to extract the hidden spatial information of traffic data","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"采用GT-SVD对交通数据张量进行奇异值分解/近似表示，以提取隐藏空间结构，属于张量分解式低秩建模。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
